content.text:
We need apply rule. Input 9x13. Pattern top-left 3x3:
P rows:
[7,8,9]
[9,9,2]
[8,9,7]

Right side cols4-12 9x9. Need identify 1s at centers of 3x3 macro blocks. Input rows:
row0-2 right all zeros.
row4: [0,0,0,5,0,0,0,0,1,0,0,1,0] full. Let's index cols4-12: c4=0,c5=0,c6=0,c7=0,c8=1,c9=0,c10=0,c11=1,c12=0.
Group macro columns: C0 c4-6, C1 c7-9, C2 c10-12.
row4 is macro row R1 (rows3-5) local row1. c8 within C1? C1 c7=0,c8=1,c9=0 -> center local (1,1). c11 within C2 c10=0,c11=1,c12=0 -> center. So macro positions R1C1, R1C2.
Other rows no 1s. So output right area: fill P in macro blocks R1C1 and R1C2; all others zero. Need produce 9x13 with separator col3=5, left pattern top-left rows0-2 cols0-2 unchanged? Based training output: left 3x3 pattern remains in rows0-2 cols0-2; rows3-8 cols0-2 zeros, col3 all 5. Right side filled.

Let's construct output grid 9 rows x13 cols.

Columns:
c0 c1 c2 | c3=5 | c4 c5 c6 | c7 c8 c9 | c10 c11 c12
Macro rows R0 rows0-2, R1 rows3-5, R2 rows6-8.

For R0 (rows0-2): macro C0,C1,C2 all zero. But left top pattern c0-2 as input rows0-2. So rows0-2:
row0: c0=7,c1=8,c2=9,c3=5, c4-12 all 0. => [7,8,9,5,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]
row1: [9,9,2,5,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]
row2: [8,9,7,5,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]

R1 rows3-5: left c0-2 zeros. Right macro C0 zeros, C1=P, C2=P.
row3 is macro row R1 local row0. c4-6 zeros (0,0,0). c7-9 = P row0 [7,8,9]. c10-12 = P row0 [7,8,9]. Thus row3: [0,0,0,5, 0,0,0, 7,8,9, 7,8,9] -> [0,0,0,5,0,0,0,7,8,9,7,8,9]
row4 local row1: c7-9 = P row1 [9,9,2]; c10-12 [9,9,2]. row4: [0,0,0,5,0,0,0,9,9,2,9,9,2]
row5 local row2: [0,0,0,5,0,0,0,8,9,7,8,9,7]

R2 rows6-8: left zeros, right all zero. Rows:
[0,0,0,5,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0] repeated three.

Check if any 1s at row? Input row4 only. Yes.

Submit via tool. Need call submit_prediction with grid. Ensure shape 9x13.
